note:
56 -> 0. Every .scss file prettier would rewrite, rewritten: 53 files across 20 modules, led by website 13 and html_editor 10. addons/web contributed nothing because the previous move (96 -> 56) had already taken it to 0.

The floor was ALREADY WRONG before this change, in the direction that fails an exact-mode lane. The tree read 53 against a floor of 56 at HEAD b0184c33f4a -- measured twice, once in the workspace and once in a detached worktree at that commit, so it was drift and not somebody uncommitted work. Three files had come clean without the floor following them down, and lint.yml runs on every push to 19.0-marin, so the lane was red for anyone who pushed. Going to 0 fixes that as a side effect of removing the debt rather than by recording it.

Whitespace only, and verified rather than argued. No character of any file changed except one: prettier added a trailing comma inside a Sass map literal in html_editor.scheme_rules.scss (map-merge($-dark-colors, ($-name: $o-dark-brand-primary,))), which Sass accepts and which changes nothing. Everything else is whitespace, and no whitespace that separates two identifiers was removed -- checked by walking both texts in parallel character by character rather than by reading the diff. The three candidates that check flagged are all whitespace before a closing paren, where CSS gives it no meaning. Most of the diff is prettier wrapping long var()/o-token()/unquote() argument lists; it did not reflow inside the quoted string in delivery map.scss, which was the one place it could have changed a value.

Compiled, not just parsed: the asset & palette lane over a 209-module install reports assets_web 32457 declarations and assets_web_dark 32455, both far above TestSchemeDuplication own 12000 partial-compile guard, so both bundles really assembled from the reformatted sources. That lane fails 7 of 52 here, and none of the 7 is this change: re-running it with the 53 files reverted and nothing else altered reproduces the identical figures, 32457/32455 and the same offender list to the unit (web 136 against a floor of 91, html_editor 28 against 17, website 19 against 13). The failures are the wider local addons_path -- enterprise and agromarin are on it and CI checks out odoo alone -- not the reformat.
